jobs.title: Marketing Full Funnel Analyst
jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

Discover your journey into the extraordinary.

Your Purpose

Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (four currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers.

An exciting opportunity exists for a talented, skilled at analysis, strategic and highly organized professional with strong marketing, digital and commercial acumen to join our newly created luxury travel brand Explora Journeys, based in our offices in Geneva, Switzerland.

Your Impact

- The objective of the role is to optimize full-funnel marketing investments holistically, maximizing revenue impact and ROI optimization across markets. This role is responsible for analysing performance across the customer journey — from awareness through loyalty — to identify growth opportunities, improve marketing efficiency, and drive commercial outcomes through data-driven decision-making.
Performance analysis: monitor and analyse marketing performance against brand and commercial KPIs, providing insights and recommendations for continuous improvement. Own the development, tracking and actioning of key marketing KPIs across touchpoint (all paid, owned and earned channels), campaigns and audience performance.

- Drive efficiency, quantifying ROI/ROAS/CPA/CPLA by campaign, touchpoint and audience for each market to continuously optimize investments. Recommend reinvestments toward highest-impact activities, to hit awareness and revenue targets.

- Build and maintain full-funnel performance scorecards by market (awareness → consideration → conversion → loyalty) to identify revenue bottlenecks and optimize budget allocation between markets. Both on Excel and partnering with corporate team to make it available in self-serve tools (Power BI).

- Develop attribution models (e.g.  media mix, multi-touch attribution) to clarify revenue contribution across platforms and improve investment efficiency.

- Partner with Marketing & Digital heads, Finance, Commercial and Revenue teams to forecast investment impacts and align marketing activities with commercial outcomes.

- Competitive analysis: monitor market conditions, competitive activity, and industry trends to support strategic planning and identify opportunities for differentiation and growth.

- Prepare executive-ready presentations, with clear data-based recommendations to support senior leadership strategic decision-making, leveraging stellar data visualization combined with depth of insights.

Your Journey so far

- 5+ years of prior experience in marketing analytics, commercial analytics, business intelligence, or performance marketing analysis.

- Preference for prior experience in the luxury hospitality/travel industry or consulting agencies.

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Marketing, Commercial, or related field (Masters, MBA or equivalent experience preferred).

Your Essentials

- Proven experience supporting senior executives and thriving in a fast-paced, start-up environment, managing multiple priorities simultaneously.

- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights.

- Highly Proficient in Excel and comfortable manipulating large datasets data and maintaining large spreadsheets with high level of accuracy

- Outstanding PowerPoint and storytelling skills — able to craft clean, crisp, high-impact presentations for C-suite audiences.

- Experience working with Salesforce, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics or similar platforms, as well as BI and visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms.

- Knowledge of marketing measurement methodologies including attribution modelling, media mix modelling, customer segmentation, and ROI analysis.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Fluent in English.

- Passion and curiosity to continuously learn about the ever-evolving travel industry.

At Explora Journeys, we are redefining luxury ocean travel — where discovery, well-being, and a deep respect for the seas come together in harmony.
We seek passionate professionals who share our vision of a more immersive, transformative way to discover the world’s most inspiring destinations by sea.
Are you ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at Explora Journeys, where an ocean of opportunities awaits. Your journey to the Ocean State of Mind starts here.

Dove la passione incontra l'opportunità Scopri il tuo viaggio nello straordinario. Il tuo scopo Explora Journeys è un marchio di lusso europeo vibrante, cosmopolita, immaginato nel cuore dell'ospitalità svizzera a Ginevra. Sfruttando le centinaia di anni di esperienza marittima della nostra società madre MSC Group, la nostra flotta di sei navi di lusso (quattro attualmente in cantiere) sono state costruite e progettate in modo totalmente diverso e unico che trasformeranno e ridefiniranno l'esperienza di crociera, creando una categoria propria, attraendo la prossima generazione di viaggiatori di lusso. Esiste un'opportunità entusiasmante per un talentuoso, esperto di analisi, un professionista strategico e altamente organizzato con un forte acume di marketing, digitale e commerciale per unire il nostro marchio di viaggio di lusso di nuova creazione Explora Journeys, con sede nei nostri uffici a Ginevra, Svizzera. Il tuo impatto - L'obiettivo del ruolo è quello di ottimizzare gli investimenti di marketing full-funnel in modo olistico, massimizzare l'impatto dei ricavi e l'ottimizzazione ROI sui mercati. Questo ruolo è responsabile dell'analisi delle prestazioni attraverso il viaggio del cliente — dalla consapevolezza attraverso la lealtà — per identificare le opportunità di crescita, migliorare l'efficienza di marketing e guidare i risultati commerciali attraverso il processo decisionale basato sui dati. Analisi delle prestazioni: monitorare e analizzare le prestazioni di marketing contro i KPI di marca e commerciali, fornendo approfondimenti e raccomandazioni per un miglioramento continuo. Possedere lo sviluppo, il monitoraggio e l'azione dei KPI di marketing chiave attraverso touchpoint (tutti i canali pagati, di proprietà e guadagnati), le campagne e le prestazioni del pubblico. - Efficienza dell'azionamento, quantificando ROI/ROAS/CPA/CPLA per campagna, touchpoint e pubblico per ogni mercato per ottimizzare continuamente gli investimenti. Raccomandare reinvestimenti verso attività ad alto impatto, per colpire obiettivi di sensibilizzazione e ricavi. - Costruisci e mantieni i segnapunti full-funnel per mercato (consapevolezza → considerazione → conversione → lealtà) per identificare i colli di bottiglia di reddito e ottimizzare l'allocazione di bilancio tra i mercati. Sia in Excel che in collaborazione con il team aziendale per renderlo disponibile negli strumenti self-serve (Power BI). - Sviluppare modelli di attribuzione (ad esempio mix media, attribuzione multi-touch) per chiarire il contributo delle entrate attraverso le piattaforme e migliorare l'efficienza degli investimenti. - Partner di Marketing & Digital Heads, Finance, Commercial and Revenue team per prevedere impatti di investimento e allineare le attività di marketing con risultati commerciali. - Analisi competitiva: monitorare le condizioni di mercato, l'attività competitiva e le tendenze del settore per sostenere la pianificazione strategica e identificare le opportunità di differenziazione e crescita. - Preparare presentazioni esecutive, con chiare raccomandazioni basate sui dati per supportare il processo decisionale strategico di leadership senior, sfruttando la visualizzazione dei dati stellari combinata con la profondità di insight. Il tuo viaggio finora - 5+ anni di esperienza precedente in analisi di marketing, analisi commerciali, business intelligence o analisi di marketing delle prestazioni. - Preferenza per esperienza precedente nel settore dell'ospitalità di lusso / viaggio o agenzie di consulenza. - Corso di laurea in Business, Economia, Finanza, Marketing, Commerciale o relativo campo (Master, MBA o equivalente esperienza preferita). I tuoi essenziali - Esperienza comprovata che supporta i dirigenti senior e prospera in un ambiente di avvio veloce, gestendo contemporaneamente più priorità. - Eccellente analitica e problem solving competenze con la capacità di tradurre i dati complessi in insight aziendali attuabili. - Eccellente in Excel e confortevole manipolazione di dati di grandi dimensioni e mantenimento di grandi fogli di calcolo con alto livello di precisione - eccezionali competenze di PowerPoint e storytelling — in grado di creare presentazioni pulite, croccanti, ad alto impatto per il pubblico C-suite. - Esperienza di lavoro con Salesforce, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics o piattaforme simili, nonché strumenti BI e di visualizzazione come Tableau, Power BI, Looker o piattaforme simili. - Conoscenza delle metodologie di misura di marketing, tra cui la modellazione dell'attribuzione, la modellazione dei media, la segmentazione dei clienti e l'analisi ROI. - Eccellente capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale. Fluente in inglese. - Passione e curiosità per conoscere continuamente l'industria del viaggio in continua evoluzione. A Explora Journeys, stiamo ridefinindo il viaggio oceanico di lusso - dove la scoperta, il benessere, e un profondo rispetto per i mari si uniscono in armonia. 
• Cerchiamo professionisti appassionati che condividono la nostra visione di un modo più coinvolgente e trasformativo per scoprire le destinazioni più ispiranti del mondo dal mare. Sei pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a Explora Journeys, dove un oceano di opportunità attende. Il vostro viaggio verso lo Stato della Mente Oceano inizia qui.

descriptionByLocale.de: Wo Leidenschaft auf Chance trifft Entdecken Sie Ihre Reise ins Außergewöhnliche. Dein Zweck Explora Journeys ist eine lebendige, kosmopolitische, europäische Luxusmarke, die im Herzen der Schweizer Gastfreundschaft in Genf vorgestellt wird. Durch die Nutzung der hundertjährigen maritimen Expertise unserer Muttergesellschaft MSC Group wird unsere Flotte von sechs Luxusschiffen (vier derzeit in der Pipeline) auf eine völlig andere und einzigartige Weise gebaut und entworfen, die das Kreuzfahrterlebnis verändern und neu definieren und eine eigene Kategorie schaffen wird, die die nächste Generation von Luxusreisenden anspricht. Eine aufregende Gelegenheit besteht für einen talentierten, fachkundigen, strategischen und hoch organisierten Fachmann mit starkem Marketing-, digitalem und kommerziellem Scharfsinn, unserer neu geschaffenen Luxusreisemarke Explora Journeys mit Sitz in unseren Büros in Genf, Schweiz, beizutreten. Ihre Wirkung Ziel der Rolle ist es, Full-Trichter-Marketing-Investitionen ganzheitlich zu optimieren, die Umsatzwirkung und die ROI-Optimierung in allen Märkten zu maximieren. Diese Rolle ist verantwortlich für die Analyse der Leistung während der gesamten Customer Journey - von Bewusstsein bis Loyalität -, um Wachstumschancen zu identifizieren, die Marketingeffizienz zu verbessern und kommerzielle Ergebnisse durch datengesteuerte Entscheidungen zu erzielen. Performance-Analyse: Überwachung und Analyse der Marketing-Performance anhand von Marken- und kommerziellen KPIs, Bereitstellung von Erkenntnissen und Empfehlungen für kontinuierliche Verbesserungen. Eigenständig für die Entwicklung, Verfolgung und Aktionierung wichtiger Marketing-KPIs über Touchpoints (alle bezahlten, eigenen und verdienten Kanäle), Kampagnen und Publikumsleistung. - Steigerung der Effizienz, Quantifizierung von ROI/ROAS/CPA/CPLA nach Kampagne, Touchpoint und Zielgruppe für jeden Markt, um die Investitionen kontinuierlich zu optimieren. Empfehlen Sie Reinvestitionen in Aktivitäten mit höchster Wirkung, um das Bewusstsein und die Umsatzziele zu erreichen. - Aufbau und Pflege von Full-Trichter-Performance-Scorecards nach Markt (Bewusstsein → Überlegung → Conversion → Loyalität), um Einnahmenengpässe zu identifizieren und die Budgetzuweisung zwischen den Märkten zu optimieren. Sowohl auf Excel als auch in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Unternehmensteam, um es in Self-Service-Tools (Power BI) verfügbar zu machen. - Entwicklung von Attributionsmodellen (z. B. Medienmix, Multi-Touch-Attribution), um den Umsatzbeitrag plattformübergreifend zu verdeutlichen und die Investitionseffizienz zu verbessern. - Partnerschaft mit Marketing & Digital Heads, Finance, Commercial und Revenue Teams, um Investitionsauswirkungen zu prognostizieren und Marketingaktivitäten an kommerziellen Ergebnissen auszurichten. Wettbewerbsanalyse: Marktbedingungen, Wettbewerbsaktivitäten und Branchentrends überwachen, um die strategische Planung zu unterstützen und Differenzierungs- und Wachstumsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren. Bereiten Sie führungsbereite Präsentationen mit klaren datenbasierten Empfehlungen vor, um die strategische Entscheidungsfindung in der Führungsebene zu unterstützen, indem Sie die Visualisierung von stellaren Daten in Kombination mit tiefen Einblicken nutzen. Ihre Reise zum Ocean State of Mind beginnt hier.
descriptionByLocale.fr: Où la passion rencontre des opportunités Découvrez votre voyage dans l'extraordinaire. Votre but Explora Journeys est une marque de luxe européenne dynamique et cosmopolite, imaginée au cœur de l'hospitalité suisse à Genève. Tirant parti de notre société mère MSC Group de centaines d'années d'expertise maritime, notre flotte de six navires de luxe (quatre actuellement dans le pipeline) sont en cours de construction et de conception d'une manière totalement différente et unique qui transformera et redéfinira l'expérience de croisière, créant une catégorie propre, attrayant pour la prochaine génération de voyageurs de luxe. Une opportunité passionnante s'offre à un professionnel talentueux, compétent en analyse, stratégique et hautement organisé avec une forte acuité marketing, numérique et commerciale pour rejoindre notre nouvelle marque de voyage de luxe Explora Journeys, basée dans nos bureaux à Genève, Suisse. Votre impact - L'objectif du rôle est d'optimiser globalement les investissements de marketing en plein air, en maximisant l'impact des revenus et l'optimisation du ROI sur les marchés. Ce rôle est chargé d'analyser les performances tout au long du parcours client — de la sensibilisation à la loyauté — pour identifier les possibilités de croissance, améliorer l'efficacité de la commercialisation et stimuler les résultats commerciaux par la prise de décisions fondées sur les données. Analyse des performances: suivre et analyser les performances de commercialisation par rapport aux KPI commerciaux et de marque, fournissant des informations et des recommandations pour l'amélioration continue. Posséder le développement, le suivi et l'action des principaux KPI marketing à travers le point de contact (tous les canaux payés, propriétaires et gagnés), les campagnes et la performance du public. - Conduire l'efficacité, quantifier ROI/ROAS/CPA/CPLA par campagne, point de contact et audience pour chaque marché afin d'optimiser continuellement les investissements. Recommander des réinvestissements vers des activités à impact le plus élevé, pour atteindre des objectifs de sensibilisation et de revenus. - Construisez et maintenez des fiches de performance full-funnel par marché (conscience → considération → conversion → fidélité) pour identifier les goulots d'étranglement et optimiser l'allocation budgétaire entre les marchés. À la fois sur Excel et en partenariat avec l'équipe d'entreprise pour le rendre disponible dans des outils en libre-service (Power BI). - Élaborer des modèles d'attribution (p. ex. mélange de médias, attribution multi-touch) pour clarifier la contribution des recettes sur les différentes plateformes et améliorer l'efficacité des investissements. - S'associer avec les responsables du marketing et du numérique, les équipes des finances, du commerce et du revenu pour prévoir les impacts sur l'investissement et aligner les activités de marketing sur les résultats commerciaux. - Analyse concurrentielle : surveiller les conditions du marché, les activités concurrentielles et les tendances de l'industrie pour appuyer la planification stratégique et identifier les possibilités de différenciation et de croissance. - Préparer des présentations prêtes pour les cadres supérieurs, avec des recommandations claires fondées sur des données pour appuyer la prise de décisions stratégiques des cadres supérieurs, en tirant parti de la visualisation des données stellaires combinée à la profondeur des idées. Votre voyage jusqu'à présent - 5 ans et plus d'expérience dans l'analyse marketing, l'analyse commerciale, l'intelligence d'affaires ou l'analyse marketing performance. - préférence pour l'expérience antérieure dans l'hôtellerie de luxe/l'industrie du voyage ou les agences de conseil. - Baccalauréat en affaires, économie, finances, marketing, commercial ou domaine connexe (maîtrise, MBA ou expérience équivalente préférée). Vos essentiels - Expérience éprouvée pour soutenir les cadres supérieurs et prospérer dans un environnement de démarrage rapide, en gérant simultanément plusieurs priorités. - Excellentes compétences d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes avec la capacité de traduire des données complexes en informations opérationnelles exploitables. - Hautement compétent en Excel et confortable manipulant les données des grands ensembles de données et conservant de grands tableurs avec un haut niveau de précision - Excellentes compétences en PowerPoint et en narration – capables d'élaborer des présentations propres, nettes et à impact élevé pour les auditoires C-suite. - Expérience de travail avec Salesforce, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics ou des plateformes similaires, ainsi que des outils BI et de visualisation tels que Tableau, Power BI, Looker ou des plateformes similaires. - Connaissance des méthodes de mesure de la commercialisation, y compris la modélisation de l'attribution, la modélisation de la combinaison des médias, la segmentation de la clientèle et l'analyse du ROI. - Excellente capacité de communication écrite et verbale. En anglais. - Passion et curiosité d'apprendre continuellement l'industrie du voyage en constante évolution. À Explora Journeys, nous redéfinissons le voyage maritime de luxe, où la découverte, le bien-être et le profond respect des mers s'unissent en harmonie. Nous recherchons des professionnels passionnés qui partagent notre vision d'une façon plus immersive et transformatrice de découvrir les destinations les plus inspirantes du monde par la mer. jobs.description:
Your Purpose

Do you excel at turning complexity into clarity? Are you energized by shaping ideas, challenging assumptions, and amplifying a leader’s impact?
We are seeking a New Builds Development & Delivery Manager who will act as an extension of the Senior Manager of Concept Innovation, enhancing strategic thinking, improving decision‑making speed, and helping bring robust, high-quality concepts to senior leadership.
This role is not operational and not a presentation-updating position. It is a partnership role, designed for someone who can think critically, structure ambiguous problems, challenge insights, and support the development of transformational guest experience concepts.You will collaborate closely with stakeholders across Experience, Retail, Marketing, Newbuild, and Strategy, ensuring concepts are analytically sound, insight-driven, and aligned with the company expectations. You’ll gain exposure to strategic discussions, influence senior decision-making, and drive clarity across innovation workstreams.
If you are a sharp thinker, a natural challenger, and a trusted partner able to elevate the work of others, this is the role for you

Your Impact

Strategic Support & Thought Partnership

- Act as a direct strategic partner to the Senior Manager, helping structure thinking, frame problems, and sharpen concept narratives.

- Participate in or lead selected meetings on behalf of Guest Experience Innovation

- Prepare strategic briefs, decision frameworks, and synthesis documents for SVP-level conversations.

Narrative Building & Executive-Ready Communication

- Craft clear, concise, and strategically sound storytelling materials for leadership forums

- Transform complex information into high-impact narratives.

- Support leadership in preparing for SVP/EVP/Executive Committee discussions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Engage with Experience, Entertainment, Retail, Marketing, Newbuild, Strategy, and Operations teams to gather insights and shape concepts.

- Lead the development and delivery of new entertainment concepts, experiences, and spaces across our fleet.

- Act as the key link between creative partners, operations, and corporate functions, ensuring alignment and buy-in at every stage.

Project & Stakeholder Management

- Drive clarity in workstreams by structuring timelines, identifying decision points, and anticipating risks.

- Follow up with stakeholders to ensure progress and alignment.

- Elevate issues early and propose mitigation scenarios.

Your Journey so far

- 5–8 years in strategy, innovation, business design, consulting, or strategic project management.

- Experience in hospitality, cruise, retail, consumer goods, or guest experience is a strong plus.

- Strong background in designing and executing guest-focused experiences, from concept to delivery.

- A balance of creativity and operational know-how, able to dream big and deliver practically.

- Proven track record in managing complex, cross-functional teams (operations, creative, marketing, sales, revenue, communications), with the ability to unite diverse perspectives around a single vision.

- Excellent knowledge of modern visual communication tools (Canva, Adobe Suite, AI-driven creative platforms) to produce compelling visual documents and storytelling assets beyond traditional slide decks.

- Excellent relationship-building skills; able to inspire, influence, and connect across diverse teams.

- Strong storytelling and presentation skills, with confidence at the executive level.

- Ability to travel 20-30% of the time.

- Fluent English; additional languages a plus.

Your Essentials

- Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

- EU Passport or right to work in Switzerland.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

jobs.title: Brand Manager - Brand & Product
jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

Discover your journey into the extraordinary.

Your Purpose

Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (four currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers.

Part of the global Marketing team and reporting directly to the Brand Director, this role plays a central role in safeguarding, shaping and activating the Explora Journeys brand across all touchpoints, with a particular focus on brand campaigns, the fleet and new brand developments.

Based at our headquarters in Geneva, this role sits at the intersection of brand strategy, product storytelling, and execution, working closely with Product, Design, Hotel Operations, Commercial, PR, Media, and Digital teams to bring the brand to life with clarity, consistency and emotional depth, across markets.

Your Impact

Brand Management & Governance

- Act as a core guardian of the Explora Journeys brand, supporting the Brand Director in the day to day management, development, and evolution of the brand.

- Ensure consistent application of brand identity, tone of voice, messaging, and visual language across all touchpoints, channels, and guest journeys.

- Lead the development, evolution and maintenance of brand guidelines, frameworks, and master toolkits, ensuring relevance, clarity, and scalability globally.

- Monitor brand execution across markets and partners, proactively identifying inconsistencies and working collaboratively with stakeholders to safeguard luxury and hospitality standards.

- Contribute to brand strategy initiatives, brand evolution projects, and internal brand education, strengthening brand understanding and alignment across the organisation.

Campaigns, Content & Brand Activation

- Lead the development and delivery of master brand and product campaigns, in line with brand strategy and commercial priorities.

- Oversee the creation of hero brand and product assets, including key visuals, copy frameworks, brochures, photography, and videography.

- Work closely with Media, Digital, and PR teams to ensure a coherent  and premium brand expression across paid, owned, and earned channels.

- Manage and curate brand, product and fleet content within DAM and PIM systems, ensuring accuracy, ease of use and global market adoption.

Product Marketing – Fleet & Onboard Experience

- Own and articulate the brand and product narrative for the Explora Journeys fleet, translating ship design, onboard experiences and service philosophy into compelling, clear, and guest-centric storytelling.

- Act as a key brand partner to Product, New Builds and Hotel Operations teams, supporting projects throughout the ship lifecycle; from early concept through delivery, launch and in-service evolution.

- Define and activate ship level propositions and concepts, onboard experiences, suite concepts, culinary, wellness and retail pillars, and service rituals.

- Ensure alignment between the onboard guest experience and the brand promise communicated to market.

Launch & Go to Market Coordination

- Support brand and product readiness for new brand initiatives, campaigns, ship launches, major milestones, and onboard innovations.

- Develop master launch toolkits to equip channels, markets, Sales, and PR with clear narratives, positioning and assets.

- Ensure consistency, clarity and brand alignment across all internal and external communications related to brand, fleet and product evolution.

Cross Functional Collaboration & Operational Excellence

- Act as a trusted brand partner across functions, fostering alignment between brand, product, commercial, and operational teams

- Coordinate budgets, suppliers, forecasting, purchase orders, and invoicing related to brand initiatives.

- Balance strategic brand thinking with hands on execution in a fast paced environment.

Your Journey so far

- Master’s degree in Marketing, Brand Management, Product Marketing, or a related field.

- 8+ years’ experience in brand management and campaign building.

- Prior experience within luxury, premium or high-end travel, hospitality or consumer brands strongly preferred.

- Proven experience operating in a global headquarters environment, managing brand frameworks and master assets across markets.

- Experience managing agencies and external creative partners.

Your Essentials

- Exposure to product marketing and physical experience‑based products (ships, hotels, resorts, or complex premium environments highly desirable).

- Strong creative sensibility combined with operational rigour, attention to detail and stakeholder management skills.

- Comfortable moving between strategic brand thinking and detailed execution.

- Fluent in English; additional European languages are a strong advantage.

At Explora Journeys, we are redefining luxury ocean travel — where discovery, well-being, and a deep respect for the seas come together in harmony.
We seek passionate professionals who share our vision of a more immersive, transformative way to discover the world’s most inspiring destinations by sea.
Are you ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at Explora Journeys, where an ocean of opportunities awaits. Your journey to the Ocean State of Mind starts here.

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The Junior Architect supports the Port Development team through fast and accurate production of conceptual and technical drawings.
The role is focused on internal execution: transforming design inputs into conceptual documentation and effective visualizations to support decision-making across private destinations, cruise terminals, port infrastructure and related facilities.

Your Impact

- Support the translation of business and design inputs into zoning studies, basic spatial diagrams, and architectural layouts.

- Assist in the development of preliminary layouts following internal design guidance and operational requirements.

- Prepare early stage conceptual design packages for internal review and coordination.

- Produce presentation decks, diagrams, visual narratives, and material boards to support internal communication.

- Develop mandatory 3D models and real time visualizations to support internal reviews and executive level presentations.

- Rapidly update, correct, and revise architectural drawings, including plans, sections, elevations, layouts, façade studies, and circulation diagrams.

- Adapt and coordinate port and civil drawings, including site layouts, infrastructure interfaces, circulation roads, and hardscape coordination.

Your Journey so far

- Strong passion for architecture and the world of interiors, materials and spatial composition.

- Curious and design-oriented, with attention to proportion, atmosphere and detail.

- Execution-driven and highly operational.

- Fast in drawing production and revisions.

- Detail-oriented and structured.

- Comfortable working under tight timelines in a dynamic development environment.

Your Essentials

- Advanced proficiency in AutoCAD with strong drafting speed and precision.

- Strong 3D modeling capabilities in SketchUp or Revit (SketchUp preferred).

- Mandatory experience with real-time rendering tools (Enscape, Twinmotion or equivalent).

- Good knowledge of Photoshop for post-production and corrections.

- Basic knowledge of (or interest in) AI tools such as Stable Diffusion or Magnific AI.

- The ability to independently produce clear, standard-quality visualizations for internal decision-making.

- Portfolio including technical drawings and rendered visualizations to be shared with the CV.

The Junior Architect Port Development Intern must be enrolled in a study program requiring a valid internship agreement. Candidates must hold an EU passport or have the legal right to work in Switzerland. Full professional proficiency in English is required; additional languages are an advantage.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

Lead Onboard Casino Technical teams, ensuring smooth operations, maintaining high standards of service, and maximising revenue generation. As a Casino Slot and Technical Operations Manager, you will be responsible for monitoring slot machine performance, analysing gaming data, and implementing strategies to enhance player satisfaction and profitability. Your role will involve regular inspections and maintenance scheduling to ensure all slot machines are functioning correctly and efficiently. You will also be responsible for managing inventory, ordering new equipment, and coordinating installations and upgrades. You will be expected to stay updated on industry trends and emerging technologies, proactively adapting operations to maintain compliance and competitive advantage.

Your Impact

• Oversee all technical projects and actively participate in their implementation. Maintain an excellent line of communication with the shore and ship technical department to ensure all casino projects are deployed according to schedule and comply to the company’s technical and safety standards.
• Assist with budgeting, forecasting and revenue analysis.
• Manage budgets, control costs, and optimise resource allocation.
• Support and guide onboard Casino management team on each vessel through constant communication and regular ship operational visits. Discuss any areas of concern specific to the Operation and brand specific product, and similarly address points of commendation.
• Provide accurate and objective assessment of onboard Casino operations and personnel.
• Revenue analysis, identifying trends with the ability to create structured solutions to increase or enhance revenue streams. • Isolate areas falling below standard with members of the Casino Shipboard management team.
• Training of all management teams in Slot Revenue, Security and Surveillance.
• Confirm that security measures meet minimum requirements.
• Provide troubleshooting support and advice via email to shipboard technical teams.
• Assess, evaluate and review data for organizing projects and/or providing directions on activities, tasks or processes in accordance with company guidelines.

Your Journey so far

• Minimum 5 years of experience in casino slot operations management.
• Previous experience working on a cruise ship is mandatory.

Your Essentials

• Strong knowledge of gaming regulations and compliance requirements.
• Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
• Proficiency in analysing gaming data and financial reports.
• Ability to manage budgets, control costs, and optimize resources.

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The Head of Learning & Development (Onboard & Ashore) and Talent Management (Ashore) is responsible for defining and leading the global strategy for Learning and Development across both shipboard and shore-based employees, while overseeing Talent Management and Succession Planning for shore-based populations only.
The role ensures the company develops the capabilities required to deliver exceptional guest experiences, operational excellence, and strong leadership across a global workforce, including thousands of shipboard crew and a diverse shore-based organization.
For shipboard employees, the role focuses on building world-class operational and service capabilities through structured training, leadership development, and career progression frameworks that support fleet performance and guest satisfaction.
For shore-based employees, the role leads both Learning & Development and Talent Management, including leadership development, succession planning, and talent pipeline development for corporate and operational leadership roles.
Working closely with senior operational leaders across Operations, Guest Experience, and Corporate Functions, this role drives a culture of continuous learning, leadership excellence, and organizational capability building across the company’s global operations.

Your Impact

Global Learning & Development Strategy (Onboard & Ashore)

- Define and implement the global Learning & Development strategy covering both shipboard crew and shore-based employees.

- Develop an integrated learning ecosystem that supports operational excellence onboard and leadership capability ashore.

- Ensure learning initiatives directly support strategic priorities such as:

- guest experience excellence

- safety and compliance

- operational performance

- leadership effectiveness

- digital and business transformation

- Oversee onboarding and development frameworks to accelerate employee integration and performance across both shipboard and shore environments.

- Lead the adoption of modern learning approaches including digital learning, simulation-based training, microlearning, and blended learning solutions.

Shipboard Learning & Development

- Lead the design and delivery of the global shipboard learning and development strategy across the fleet.

- Partner closely with Marine Operations, Hotel Operations, Food & Beverage, and Guest Experience leadership to ensure training programs support operational priorities and service excellence.

- Ensure consistent training standards across the fleet while accommodating the operational realities of shipboard environments.

- Oversee development programs for key shipboard roles, including supervisory and management development programs for future onboard leaders.

- Support structured career development pathways for shipboard crew, enabling internal progression across hospitality and operational functions.

- Ensure alignment with all maritime regulatory training requirements and safety standards.

Shore-Based Learning & Development

- Lead the design and implementation of learning and development programs for shore-based employees across corporate and operational functions.

- Develop capability-building initiatives supporting key business priorities such as:

- commercial capabilities

- digital transformation

- operational excellence

- guest-centric culture

- Design structured leadership development programs for emerging, mid-level, and senior leaders.

- Develop functional academies and capability frameworks supporting critical corporate disciplines.

Talent Management & Succession Planning (Ashore Only)

- Define and implement the company’s global talent management strategy for shore-based employees.

- Lead processes for:

- talent identification and talent reviews

- succession planning for critical leadership roles

- high-potential development programs

- leadership pipeline development

- career development frameworks

- Partner with executive leadership and HR Business Partners to ensure strong succession pipelines for key corporate and operational leadership positions ashore.

- Embed talent management practices into performance management and leadership development frameworks.

Leadership Development

- Design and implement leadership development programs supporting both shipboard and shore-based leadership populations.

- Establish a global leadership framework aligned with the company’s values and guest-centric culture.

- Strengthen leadership capabilities in areas such as:

- people leadership

- operational decision-making

- service excellence

- innovation and continuous improvement

- cross-cultural leadership

Your Journey so far

Education

- Master’s degree in Human Resources, Organizational Development, Business Administration, or related field.

Experience

- 15+ years of progressive experience in Learning & Development, Talent Management, or Organizational Development.

- Significant experience designing and implementing global learning strategies for large, international workforces.

- Proven experience leading talent management and succession planning programs for corporate leadership populations.

- Experience in cruise, hospitality, travel, aviation, or other large service-driven organizations strongly preferred.

- Experience working in highly multicultural and geographically distributed environments.

Key Competences

- Strategic Learning & Capability Development

- Talent Management & Succession Planning (Corporate)

- Service Excellence & Hospitality Culture

- Stakeholder Influence & Executive Partnership

- Global Mindset & Cultural Intelligence

- Organizational Development

- Learning Technology & Digital Learning

Your Essentials

- Fluency in English is required; Italian, French, German or other European languages are a plus.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il tuo scopo

The Head of Learning & Development (Onboard & Ashore) e Talent Management (Ashore) è responsabile per la definizione e la guida della strategia globale per l'apprendimento e lo sviluppo su entrambi i dipendenti della nave e della riva, mentre supervisiona Talent Management e la pianificazione di successo per le popolazioni a base di riva.
Il ruolo assicura che l'azienda sviluppi le capacità necessarie per offrire esperienze ospiti eccezionali, l'eccellenza operativa e una forte leadership in una forza lavoro globale, tra cui migliaia di equipaggio di bordo e una diversa organizzazione a base di riva.
Per i dipendenti di bordo, il ruolo si concentra sulla costruzione di capacità operative e di servizio di livello mondiale attraverso la formazione strutturata, lo sviluppo di leadership e le strutture di progressione di carriera che supportano le prestazioni della flotta e la soddisfazione degli ospiti.
Per i dipendenti a base di riva, il ruolo guida sia Learning & Development che Talent Management, tra cui sviluppo di leadership, pianificazione di successione e sviluppo di talenti pipeline per ruoli di leadership aziendale e operativa.
Lavorando a stretto contatto con i leader operativi senior in Operazioni, Esperienza degli Ospiti e Funzioni aziendali, questo ruolo guida una cultura dell’apprendimento continuo, dell’eccellenza della leadership e della capacità organizzativa attraverso le operazioni globali dell’azienda.

Il tuo impatto

Global Learning & Development Strategy (Onboard & Ashore)

- Definire e implementare la strategia globale di apprendimento e sviluppo che copre sia l'equipaggio di bordo che i dipendenti a base di riva.

- Sviluppare un ecosistema di apprendimento integrato che supporta l'eccellenza operativa a bordo e la capacità di leadership a terra.

- Assicurarsi che le iniziative di apprendimento supportino direttamente le priorità strategiche come:

- eccellenza dell'esperienza degli ospiti

- sicurezza e conformità

- prestazioni operative

- efficacia della leadership

- trasformazione digitale e commerciale

- Superare i quadri di bordo e di sviluppo per accelerare l'integrazione e le prestazioni dei dipendenti sia in ambienti di bordo che in riva.

- Guidare l'adozione di approcci di apprendimento moderni, tra cui apprendimento digitale, formazione basata sulla simulazione, microlearning e soluzioni di apprendimento misto.

Imparare & Sviluppo

- Guidare la progettazione e la consegna della strategia globale di apprendimento e sviluppo del bordo nave in tutta la flotta.

- Collaborare a stretto contatto con Marine Operations, Hotel Operations, Food & Beverage e Guest Experience per garantire ai programmi di formazione le priorità operative e l'eccellenza dei servizi.

- Assicurare standard di formazione coerenti in tutta la flotta, accompagnando le realtà operative degli ambienti di bordo.

- supervisionare i programmi di sviluppo per i ruoli chiave della nave, compresi i programmi di supervisione e sviluppo della gestione per i futuri leader a bordo.

- Supporta percorsi di sviluppo di carriera strutturati per l'equipaggio di bordo, consentendo progressione interna attraverso l'ospitalità e le funzioni operative.

- Assicurare l'allineamento con tutti i requisiti di formazione normativa marittima e standard di sicurezza.

Apprendimento e sviluppo basati sugli urti

- Guidare la progettazione e l'implementazione di programmi di apprendimento e sviluppo per i dipendenti basati sulla riva attraverso funzioni aziendali e operative.

- Sviluppare iniziative di creazione di capacità a sostegno delle principali priorità aziendali come:

- capacità commerciali

- trasformazione digitale

- eccellenza operativa

Dein Zweck

Der Head of Learning & Development (Onboard & Ashore) und Talent Management (Ashore) ist dafür verantwortlich, die globale Strategie für Lernen und Entwicklung sowohl für Mitarbeiter an Bord als auch an Land zu definieren und zu leiten, während er Talent Management und Nachfolgeplanung nur für an Land ansässige Bevölkerungen überwacht.
Die Rolle stellt sicher, dass das Unternehmen die Fähigkeiten entwickelt, die erforderlich sind, um außergewöhnliche Gästeerlebnisse, operative Exzellenz und eine starke Führungsrolle in einer globalen Belegschaft zu bieten, darunter Tausende von Schiffsbesatzungen und eine vielfältige landgestützte Organisation.
Für Mitarbeiter an Bord von Schiffen konzentriert sich die Rolle auf den Aufbau von erstklassigen Betriebs- und Servicefähigkeiten durch strukturierte Schulungen, Führungsentwicklung und Karriereentwicklungsrahmen, die die Leistung der Flotte und die Gästezufriedenheit unterstützen.

- Guest Experience Exzellenz

- Sicherheit und Compliance

- Betriebsleistung

- Führungseffektivität

- Digitale und Business Transformation

Shipboard Learning & Development

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The Senior Digital Acquisition Manager will be responsible for leading the digital marketing strategy across all MSC Cruises markets, with a focus on driving direct sales through digital advertising levers, setting and achieving KPIs, and developing innovative digital campaigns across multiple channels. The successful candidate will have a proven track record in performance marketing and digital sales development at a positive ROAS, along with strong expertise in digital advertising campaign strategy, paid media planning and implementation, and team leadership. Additionally, the role will involve developing affiliation and partnership programs as part of an integrated digital engagement strategy to broaden reach, drive qualified traffic, and support long-term customer value.

Your Impact

• Develop and maintain strong relationships with MSC stakeholders across various markets, with a deep understanding of their business needs, challenges, and opportunities—while balancing the global objectives set by headquarters.

• Set and achieve KPIs for online sales through digital advertising levers, ensuring the media agency delivers against targets and contractual obligations.

• Lead internal meetings, QBRs, and annual reviews by providing strategic insights and recommendations based on campaign performance, website analytics, market trends, and the competitive landscape.

• Plan and implement innovative performance marketing campaigns across Paid Search, Display, Social, Native, Digital Audio, and Video channels—tailored to business goals and market dynamics.

• Collaborate with internal teams—including Creative, Social Media, Data & Analytics, SEO, Content, Product, and agency partners—to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality assets aligned with annual digital sales targets.

• Identify and pursue opportunities to enhance revenue streams through existing and new digital strategies, while improving campaign ROAS and experimenting with innovations in the adtech and martech ecosystem.

• Develop and manage lead generation strategies, ensuring effective customer acquisition flows and nurturing tactics are in place across all paid media touchpoints.

• Maintain oversight of account resourcing and profitability to ensure HQ and local markets are managed efficiently and profitably.

• Serve as the main escalation point for concerns raised by internal teams or local market stakeholders.

• Continuously review and optimize operational workflows, proposing and implementing process improvements where relevant.

• Collaborate with country and HQ stakeholders to prepare and manage the annual digital marketing budget, aligned with MSC Cruises’ B2C revenue goals.

• Lead and optimize affiliate and partnership programs to drive qualified traffic and conversions, ensuring alignment with digital acquisition strategy and performance goals.

• Manage key partners and co-branded initiatives, coordinating with internal teams to ensure seamless execution and tracking.

Your Journey so far

• 7+ years of experience in a similar role.
• Hands-on experience with analytics and ad server tools such as GA4, Adobe Analytics, Campaign Manager and their relevant reporting frameworks.
• Proven experience in managing, mentoring, and upskilling team members.
• Past experience in lead generation strategy and execution is a strong plus.
• Solid experience in budget ownership and cost control.

Your Essentials

• Fluent in English (additional languages are a plus).
• Strong analytical skills and the ability to leverage data for informed decision-making.
• Proven track record of driving direct sales growth and improving ROAS through high-performing digital advertising campaigns.
• Passion for digital marketing, performance media, and innovative digital solutions.
• Deep knowledge of Google and Meta ad platforms, including setup auditing, implementation, and performance analysis with actionable insights.
• Excellent organizational, project management, and problem-solving skills.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office and data visualization tools such as Datorama.
• Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams and external partners.
• Ability to identify trends in data and transform insights into actionable strategic recommendations.
• Self-starter with the ability to work independently and take initiative.
• Confident, articulate presenter—comfortable engaging with senior stakeholders and internal teams.
• Strong strategic thinking, capable of acting as a ‘Trusted Advisor’ to senior leadership.
• High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
• Positive attitude, proactive mindset, and a drive to embrace new challenges.
• Knowledge of affiliate platforms such as Awin, Kwanko, and similar tools. Strong network of industry contacts to initiate partnership opportunities and brand collaborations.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The Digital Analytics Strategy, Testing and CRO Manager will be responsible for driving D2C growth through data-driven experimentation and strategic optimization of our direct digital channels. You will spearhead our testing and insights strategy to maximize conversion rates, booking volumes and revenue per visitor, while building a best-in-class experimentation practice that delivers sustainable competitive advantage. This role will have a strong strategic focus on the direct channel, optimizing lead generation, and leveraging insights to drive higher customer acquisition, engagement, and lifetime value.

Your Impact

• Design and execute a comprehensive data driven strategy across all digital touchpoints, with particular focus on driving direct channel growth and reducing acquisition costs through improved conversion rates.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product, design, engineering, marketing, and web analytics to conceptualize and design A/B tests that effectively measure the impact of website and campaign changes.

• Drive strategic initiatives within the direct channel, ensuring a data-driven approach to lead generation, audience segmentation, and customer journey optimization to improve conversion and engagement.

• Develop deep customer journey insights through advanced analytics, identifying key friction points and opportunities to enhance the user experience and drive higher booking values.

• Perform advanced digital segmentation analyses to uncover high-value customer segments and personalization opportunities across the conversion funnel.

• Establish robust measurement frameworks to quantify the commercial impact of optimization initiatives, including test design, revenue forecasting, and post-implementation analysis.

• Develop comprehensive performance dashboards that combine testing results, customer behavior metrics, and commercial KPIs to guide conversion rate optimization.

• Drive innovation in personalization and optimization strategies to maximize direct channel contribution using the newly adopted tools (Adobe Analytics, Adobe Target, Real-time CDP).

• Develop testing frameworks that balance quick wins with longer-term strategic initiatives.

Your Journey so far

• Degree in business, marketing, analytics, or a related field, with 5 years of relevant experience.

• Proven track record of leveraging D2C data insights to shape marketing and product strategies, particularly in booking funnel optimization.

• Hands-on experience with A/B testing tools like Adobe Target.

Your Essentials

• Expertise in web analytics platforms such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics and AEP.

• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to distill complex data into actionable business strategies.

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and influence decision-making.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment, managing multiple initiatives simultaneously.

• EU Passport or right to work in Switzerland.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!
